SECTION 1: HERO.label: Headline
text: Be ambitious about your whole life.

SECTION 1: HERO.label: Supporting headline
text: Create the life you want. Enjoy the life you have.

SECTION 1: HERO.label: Body
text: Make choices that feel like yours. Build relationships where you can speak honestly. Move forward on what matters—and enjoy more of the life you’re creating.

Drawing on 20 years as a U.S. diplomat, I help you develop the self-understanding, perspective, and practical skills to navigate life with greater confidence and fulfillment so that you can access your diplomat within.

text: Request an Introductory Conversation

SECTION 1: HERO.label: Supporting text
text: Complimentary · 20 minutes · Virtual sessions available

SECTION 2: RECOGNITION.label: Heading
text: You can have a good life and still want more from it.

SECTION 2: RECOGNITION.label: Body
text: You know how to work hard, follow through, and make things happen. Yet knowing what you can achieve doesn’t always answer what you want—or how you want your life to feel.

Perhaps your responsibilities keep expanding while your own aspirations wait. You find yourself second-guessing decisions, holding yourself to exhausting standards, or agreeing to things that leave little room for what you need.
Or life is going well, and you want to participate in it more fully: deepen relationships, explore an ambition, protect your wellbeing, or enjoy what you’ve worked to create.
Whatever brings you here, I believe you deserve to be as intentional about the quality of your life as you are about the things you accomplish within it.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Heading
text: Develop the diplomat within.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Body
text: Diplomats learn to understand interests, listen beneath the surface, consider different perspectives, and find a way forward when needs compete and answers are uncertain.
Those capabilities are valuable in everyday life, too.

They begin with knowing yourself: what you value, what you need, where your boundaries are, and what you want to pursue. They grow through how you listen, communicate, make decisions, and respond to the people and circumstances around you.
Developing the diplomat within helps you become more grounded in yourself and more effective in shaping your life.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Item 1 heading
text: Know your own interests.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Body
text: Understand your values, needs, and aspirations, and distinguish them from expectations you have absorbed along the way.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Outcome
text: Make decisions with a clearer sense of what you want and what you are willing to trade for it.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Item 2 heading
text: See beyond your first interpretation.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Body
text: Notice assumptions, question expectations, and consider what else may be happening—for you and for another person.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Outcome
text: Spend less energy second-guessing or personalizing situations, and respond with greater perspective.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Item 3 heading
text: Communicate with clarity and respect.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Body
text: Learn to express your needs, listen carefully, understand different interests, and navigate disagreement.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Outcome
text: Have the conversations you’ve been avoiding, set clearer boundaries, and work toward agreements that respect your needs and the relationship.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Item 4 heading
text: Find your footing when things are uncertain.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Body
text: Recognize your emotions, assess your options, and make thoughtful decisions without requiring perfect information.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Outcome
text: Take the next step with greater confidence, adjust when necessary, and build trust in your judgment.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Item 5 heading
text: Turn priorities into a way of living.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Body
text: Translate what matters into manageable actions while making space to appreciate what is already meaningful and good.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Outcome
text: Make progress on your aspirations and experience more enjoyment along the way.

SECTION 3: DEFINE THE DIPLOMAT WITHIN.label: Closing
text: These capabilities develop together. Knowing your needs helps you communicate them. Having an honest conversation can deepen your understanding. Following through on a small commitment can strengthen self-trust.
You build a way of approaching life that you can continue using as your priorities and circumstances evolve.

SECTION 4: THE DIFFERENCE IN MY APPROACH.label: Heading
text: Understand what will actually help.

SECTION 4: THE DIFFERENCE IN MY APPROACH.label: Body
text: When something feels wrong, it can be difficult to know what needs to change.
Dissatisfaction with work might call for a new role. It might also point to exhaustion, unclear boundaries, a difficult relationship, or expectations that no job could reasonably meet.
We look at both your circumstances and your experience of them. What is happening? What are you assuming? Whose expectations are influencing you? What matters enough to act on?

I bring the listening, perspective-taking, and practical judgment I developed through diplomacy to help you explore those questions. Together, we identify where a conversation, a decision, a different perspective, or a practical change could help.
The purpose is to strengthen your ability to understand a situation and choose a response that serves what matters to you to unleash your diplomat within.

SECTION 4: THE DIFFERENCE IN MY APPROACH.label: Pull quote
text: Know what to change, what to appreciate, and how to move forward.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Heading
text: Leave with a clearer direction and a practical next step.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Introduction
text: Bring a decision, a challenge, an aspiration—or the feeling that you want something to be different but haven’t quite named it.
There is no single formula for a fulfilling life. What brings one person joy, meaning, and satisfaction may look completely different for someone else.
Sometimes fulfillment requires changing something about our circumstances. Sometimes it requires changing how we see or experience the lives we're already living. Often, it's both.
I believe we can be ambitious without demanding perfection. Accountable without being cruel to ourselves. Grateful for what we have while still pursuing what we want.
We can learn to navigate challenges, make intentional choices, strengthen our relationships, and create space for experiences that make life meaningful.
And we can do all of that without turning the pursuit of a good life into another source of pressure.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Service 1 heading
text: Start with a conversation.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Details
text: Complimentary introductory conversation · 20 minutes

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Body
text: Tell me what brings you here, ask questions, and get a sense of how I work. We’ll explore what you want from the experience and whether my approach feels like a good fit.
There's no pressure to commit. This is simply our opportunity to meet and decide whether to take the next step.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Button
text: Request an Introductory Conversation

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Service 2 heading
text: Your Whole-Life Strategy Session

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Details
text: Whole-Life Strategy Session | 90 minutes

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Body
text: If we decide to move forward, we'll begin with a personalized experience designed to help you step outside the demands of everyday life and reflect on what you genuinely want from it.

We'll explore what brings you joy and fulfillment, where you may feel dissatisfied or disconnected, what you want to create or experience, and the patterns, habits, or expectations that may be influencing your choices.
Together, we'll identify meaningful priorities and practical steps toward creating - and enjoying - the life you want.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Includes heading
text: Your Whole-Life Strategy experience includes:

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Included item 1
text: A brief pre-session reflection
A few thoughtful questions to help you consider where you are and what you'd like to explore.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Included item 2
text: A 90-minute personal strategy session
Dedicated time to reflect, gain perspective, identify priorities, and develop a direction that feels right for you.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Included item 3
text: Your personalized Whole-Life Action Roadmap
A concise written summary of key insights, priorities, and achievable next steps.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Closing
text: The aim is to leave with a clearer understanding of your situation, a direction that reflects your priorities, and specific steps you can begin taking.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Service 3 heading
text: Continue the journey.

SECTION 5: WORK WITH ME.label: Body
text: The Whole-Life Strategy Session provides a valuable starting point, but meaningful and lasting change often benefits from continued attention and support.

For those who want to go further, I offer personalized, longer-term advisory engagements. Together, we can build on the insights from your Strategy Session, put your plans into practice, navigate obstacles, and adjust your approach as your life evolves.
As you act, reflect, and adjust, you develop greater confidence in understanding yourself, navigating relationships, and choosing your response to new situations.
The focus and rhythm of our work are shaped around your priorities and circumstances.

SECTION 6: RESULTS AND PHILOSOPHY.label: Heading
text: Progress you can see—and feel.

SECTION 6: RESULTS AND PHILOSOPHY.label: Body
text: Progress might mean making a decision you have postponed, expressing a need clearly, protecting time for something important, or following through on a goal.
It might also mean less time questioning your worth, more realistic expectations of yourself, or enjoying an ordinary day without feeling you should be doing more.
We pay attention to both.
The skills you develop can help you act more deliberately and experience your life with greater self-trust, connection, and contentment.

SECTION 6: RESULTS AND PHILOSOPHY.label: Supporting heading
text: Create the life you want. Enjoy the life you have.

SECTION 6: RESULTS AND PHILOSOPHY.label: Body
text: You can pursue an ambition and appreciate where you are. Take responsibility for your choices and treat yourself kindly when things don’t go to plan. Accept an imperfection and address a problem that deserves your attention.
Being ambitious about your whole life means giving conscious attention to what makes life meaningful and enjoyable for you.

SECTION 6: RESULTS AND PHILOSOPHY.label: Pull quote
text: Love your life for what it is, and forgive it for what it isn’t.

SECTION 7: ABOUT LYLA.label: Heading
text: Meet Lyla.

SECTION 7: ABOUT LYLA.label: Subheading
text: A diplomat’s perspective on a fulfilling life.

SECTION 7: ABOUT LYLA.label: Body
text: I’m Lyla Bashan. I spent two decades as a U.S. diplomat working with people across cultures to navigate complex challenges, build relationships, address conflict, and turn ambitious goals into practical action.
That experience taught me to listen beneath the first explanation, understand competing interests, and find possibilities when the way forward was uncertain.
I’ve brought the same intentionality to my own life.

I've made intentional choices to prioritize my relationships, health, family, adventure, meaningful work, and the everyday experiences that bring me joy. I've taken breaks from my career to travel and spend time with family, embraced opportunities to live and work around the world, and navigated unexpected changes that challenged my assumptions about what life would look like.

Today, I feel deeply fulfilled by the life I've created. Not because everything has gone according to plan or because every part of life is perfect, but because I've learned to be intentional about what matters, appreciate what I have, and keep making room for what brings me joy.

I believe many of the skills that help us navigate a complicated world can also help us navigate our own lives: listening carefully, understanding different perspectives, asking thoughtful questions, recognizing possibilities, making intentional choices, and taking meaningful action.
That's what inspired The Diplomat Within.
My role isn't to tell you what your life should look like. It's to help you discover what matters to you, recognize what's possible, and develop your own way forward.
I'm also the author of Global: An Extraordinary Guide for Ordinary Heroes, and I live on Hawaiʻi Island with my family.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Heading
text: A few questions you may have.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Question
text: Do I need a specific problem or goal?

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Answer
text: You can bring a clear issue or simply a sense that you want something to feel different. We can begin by understanding your experience and identifying what would be most useful to explore.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Question
text: What does developing the diplomat within have to do with my life?

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Answer
text: Diplomacy draws on capabilities you can use every day: understanding interests, listening carefully, considering perspectives, communicating needs, negotiating differences, and making decisions amid uncertainty. We apply those capabilities to what matters to you, beginning with understanding yourself and extending into your choices, relationships, and actions.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Question
text: What is life advisory?

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Answer
text: A collaborative partnership combining reflection, perspective, practical problem-solving, and support for action. I help you examine your situation and explore your options while developing skills and judgment you can continue using. Your values and priorities guide the direction.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Question
text: What could be different after working together?

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Answer
text: You may make a decision you’ve postponed, communicate more clearly, establish a boundary, or begin making progress toward a meaningful goal. You may also experience greater self-trust, more realistic expectations, or a kinder relationship with yourself. We identify what progress would mean for you and revisit it as we work together.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Question
text: What if I don’t need a major life change?

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Answer
text: Our work can focus on enjoying and participating more fully in the life you already have. That might involve reconsidering expectations, making time for existing sources of joy, or changing how you respond to everyday challenges.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Question
text: How is this different from therapy?

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Answer
text: Life advisory focuses on life choices, aspirations, relationships, perspectives, and practical action. It does not provide psychotherapy, diagnosis, or mental health treatment. It can complement other professional support, with clear boundaries between those roles.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Question
text: Can we meet virtually?

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Answer
text: Yes. I offer virtual sessions wherever you live. In-person meetings on Hawaiʻi Island may also be arranged.

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Question
text: Do I need to commit to ongoing sessions?

SECTION 8: FAQ.label: Answer
text: You can begin with a Whole-Life Strategy Session. If continued support would be useful, we can discuss an advisory engagement that fits your priorities and circumstances.

Whether you’re ready for a change or want to enjoy your life more fully, I’d welcome a conversation.
Our complimentary 20-minute introduction is a chance to talk about what you’re looking for and see whether working together feels right.
